title: Sitemap Extractor output
description: One row per URL the site publishes, plus three key-value records that describe the run itself. The run summary is the one to read first: it says how many sitemaps were read, what went wrong, and whether the rows you have are the whole answer.

urls.title: URL rows
urls.description: Every URL found in the site's published sitemaps, one row each, with optional HTTP status codes. Fields are documented in the output schema; errorType is an enum, so problems are filterable rather than free text.

summary.title: Run summary
summary.description: What the run found and what it could not. Read truncated before concluding a site is small — it is true whenever maxUrls or a budget is why you did not get every URL, and truncateReason says which.

sitemaps.title: Sitemap files
sitemaps.description: One record per sitemap file that was read, with its own status, kind and URL count. A site that publishes 24 sitemap files produces 24 records here.

nextStep.title: Next step
nextStep.description: The run's closing note, including the offer to have these URLs watched for changes.
